mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_nm, u.email_addr, u.user_stat_cd, u.mfa_code_hash, u.mfa_expr_dttm, u.mfa_err_cnt, u.temp_pwd_yn, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_USER_ROLE ur JOIN TB_SY_ROLE r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND r.role_id='ADMIN' AND r.use_yn='Y') AS administrator FROM TB_SY_USER u WHERE u.user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE OF u
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SY_USER SET mfa_use_yn='Y', mfa_code_hash=#{hash}, mfa_expr_dttm=#{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE TB_SY_USER SET mfa_use_yn='N', mfa_code_hash=NULL, mfa_expr_dttm=NULL WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE TB_SY_USER SET mfa_err_cnt=LEAST(mfa_err_cnt+1,99) WHERE user_id=#{userId}
UPDATE TB_SY_USER SET mfa_code_hash=NULL, mfa_expr_dttm=NULL WHERE user_id=#{userId}
